label: sdc01_0440_sister_02
text: It’s a bit lonely out here, but I guess this place\nmust mean a lot to Ogerpon.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0440_sister_04
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I think Ogerpon might want to go with you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0440_brother_02
text: If it’s not gonna stay here, then I...I wanna...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0440_brother_08
text: I want Ogerpon to come with me![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0440_brother_03
text: I know I’m bein’ real selfish...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0440_brother_05
text: Let me battle you! I want to see which one of us\nshould get to keep Ogerpon with them![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0440_sister_07
text: I know you really love Ogerpon. I really, honestly\nunderstand.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0440_sister_08
text: But...you have to think about Ogerpon’s\nfeelings too.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0440_brother_07
text: So let me know once you’re ready.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
